name: Shining Legends Elite Trainer Box
extCardText:
Inside this Shining Legends Elite Trainer Box, you'll find:
• 10 Shining Legends booster packs
• 1 foil promo card featuring Shining Ho-Oh
• 65 card sleeves featuring Ho-Oh
• 45 Energy cards
• 1 player's guide to the Shining Legends expansion
• 6 damage-counter dice
• 1 competition-legal coin-flip die
• 2 acrylic condition markers and 1 acrylic GX marker
• Product can also be used as a collector's box to hold everything, with 4 dividers to keep it organized
• 1 code card for the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online

name: Shining Legends Premium Powers Collection
extCardText: Shining Pokemon of Legendary Stature! The Legendary Pokemon Ho-Oh is said to bring joy to any Trainer who sees it - particularly when it appears as a full-art promo card that paints this Rainbow Pokemon in rainbow colors! The Shining Legends Premium Powers Collection also includes never-before-seen foil cards featuring Shining Lugia, Shining Celebi, and Pikachu, plus 8 Pokemon TCG: Shining Legends booster packs and a fantastic poster that shows off 9 Shining Pokemon!
